attackers_goals: Discover resources across regions to understand the cloud deployment footprint. Target regions or services that may have weaker controls, lower visibility, or misconfiguration for potential exploitation. Build a complete view of infrastructure for lateral movement or privilege escalation.
description: Discovery API calls were executed across multiple AWS regions.
investigative_actions: Identify which services and regions were targeted. Analyze the identity performing the discovery. Correlate with other discovery or suspicious activities.
name: Cloud infrastructure discovery across multiple regions
